issue.title: just lint's _lint-test-waits fails on test_notification_gate_durability.py:69 missing pragma
issue.description: The lint gate 'just lint' -> tools/check_test_wait_helpers (_lint-test-waits recipe) fails deterministically: tests/test_notification_gate_durability.py:69 has a bare 'time.sleep(0.2)' inside the threading helper _hold_briefly() (used by test_file_lock_with_no_timeout_still_blocks_until_released) with no '# sase-test-wait: <reason>' pragma and no call through sase.ace.testing.wait.wait_for or an equivalent domain-specific helper. Fix: add an inline '# sase-test-wait: <reason>' pragma naming why this positive literal sleep is needed (it lets a background thread acquire the file lock before the main thread tries and blocks), or replace it with an observable wait if one is practical for this cross-thread flock handoff. Discovered while running 'just lint' during unrelated work (implementing sase-ug.3's projected-artifact-link-edges plan); confirmed on a clean git status for this file (I made no changes to it) so this is a true failure, not something my tree introduced.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the lint check is static analysis over the file's source text (a missing pragma comment), not a runtime race, so it fails on every invocation of 'just lint' regardless of host load or scheduling. Verified git status/diff show zero changes to this file in my working tree.
